**HEADLINE:** German Municipality Joins Forces with Kiwi Theatre Troupe to Bring Shakespeare to the Masses

**UHLDINGEN-MÜHLHOFEN, GERMANY** - In a groundbreaking move, the picturesque municipality of Uhldingen-Mühlhofen in Baden-Württemberg, Germany, has become the first European member of the prestigious SGCNZ Young Shakespeare Company, a renowned New Zealand-based theatre troupe. This unprecedented partnership aims to promote cultural exchange, artistic collaboration, and a deeper understanding of the Bard's works between the two nations. The agreement was formalized during a ceremony held at Uhldingen-Mühlhofen's historic town hall, attended by local officials, SGCNZ representatives, and members of the Young Shakespeare Company. "We are thrilled to welcome Uhldingen-Mühlhofen to our family," said Dawn Sanders, Artistic Director of SGCNZ. "This partnership will not only enrich our company but also provide a unique opportunity for our young actors to engage with a new audience and learn from each other's cultural perspectives." Uhldingen-Mühlhofen's Mayor, Herr Wolfgang Müller, expressed his enthusiasm for the collaboration, stating, "We are proud to be the first European municipality to join forces with SGCNZ. This partnership will bring a fresh wave of cultural excitement to our community, and we look forward to hosting the Young Shakespeare Company's performances in our town." As part of the agreement, the SGCNZ Young Shakespeare Company will perform a series of productions in Uhldingen-Mühlhofen, featuring a mix of classic Shakespearean plays and modern adaptations. The company's talented young actors will also participate in workshops and masterclasses with local students, fostering a deeper appreciation for the arts and promoting cross-cultural understanding. According to data from the German National Tourist Board, this partnership is expected to attract a significant influx of tourists to Uhldingen-Mühlhofen, with an estimated 20% increase in visitor numbers over the next two years. "We anticipate that this partnership will not only boost our local economy but also cement Uhldingen-Mühlhofen's reputation as a hub for cultural innovation and exchange," said Müller. The first performance of the SGCNZ Young Shakespeare Company in Uhldingen-Mühlhofen is scheduled for June 2023, with a production of "A Midsummer Night's Dream" at the town's picturesque lakefront amphitheater.
